content.title: EA (EA) Margin Compression Challenges Bullish Narrative Despite Strong Earnings Outlook
content.summary: Electronic Arts (EA) posted annual earnings growth averaging 3.2% over the past five years, while recent net profit margins have narrowed to 12.1% from 14.1% a year ago. Looking forward, analysts forecast EA’s earnings to grow at 16.5% per year, outpacing the broader US market’s 15.6% rate. However, revenue growth of 5.2% still lags market expectations.
